# Linear rail safety-pin teaching model

An independently authored split ring, stem and squeeze tabs illustrate the rail's anti-ejection pins. Green colour and handling follow the official CORE One assembly photographs. Dimensions fit the displayed 6 mm counterbore for the animation; they are illustrative, not manufacturer measurements or a replacement-part design.

- Units: millimetres.
- Producer: `build-pin.py --output <directory>`.
- Outputs: complete position/normal buffer and geometry manifest.
- License: MIT for the original producer, scalar dimensions and generated teaching geometry; see `LICENSE.txt`.

Official references: [move the pins](https://help.prusa3d.com/guide/5-corexy-assembly_835522#843531), [remove the pins](https://help.prusa3d.com/guide/5-corexy-assembly_835522#864630), [numbered rail alignment](https://help.prusa3d.com/guide/5-corexy-assembly_835522#866050). Photographs and printer CAD retain their existing Prusa Research attribution and terms.
